Allosaurus.subject: Environment & Ecology
Allosaurus.question: It coexisted with fellow large theropods _____ and Torvosaurus in both the United States and Portugal
Allosaurus.fact: It coexisted with fellow large theropods Ceratosaurus and Torvosaurus in both the United States and Portugal. Ceratosaurus and Torvosaurus may have preferred to be active around waterways, and had lower, thinner bodies that would have given them an advantage in forest and underbrush terrains, whereas Allosaurus was more compact, with longer legs, faster but less maneuverable, and seems to have preferred dry floodplains.
